title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: detention day rates for reefer-class containers
content:
## Scope

This rate card gives the detention day rates for a container of the **reefer rate class** under each product of the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category. Rates are in USD per container per day, one rate for each of the four charge slabs.

## Detention day rates, reefer class

| Product | Slab 1 (USD/day) | Slab 2 (USD/day) | Slab 3 (USD/day) | Slab 4 (USD/day) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 120.00 | 180.00 | 260.00 | 340.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 120.00 | 180.00 | 260.00 | 340.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 120.00 | 180.00 | 260.00 | 340.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 120.00 | 180.00 | 260.00 | 340.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 120.00 | 180.00 | 260.00 | 340.00 |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 96.00 | 144.00 | 208.00 | 272.00 |

The five products AHL Tariff Free Time, AHL Free Time Extension 3, AHL Free Time Extension 7, AHL Combined Free Time 14 and AHL Combined Free Time 21 share one reefer-class detention rate ladder; AHL Contract Free Time 30 has its own, lower ladder.

## Reading the card

**Q: What is the reefer-class detention day rate in slab 3 under AHL Free Time Extension 7?**
A: USD 260.00 per container per day.

**Q: What is the reefer-class detention rate for a slab 4 day under AHL Contract Free Time 30?**
A: USD 272.00 per container per day, against USD 340.00 under the other five products.

This card states the reefer-class detention rate of each slab only; the rate class of a given container and the slab of a given day are decided by the rules that govern them.
